title: Question on the page "pagination"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[pagination](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/pagination.html)".

<!-- Describe what you're looking for here. -->

I am only returning 1 or 2 hits but the pagination is still showing as a hyperlinked integer of "1". If you looked at the searchParameters.hitsPerPage and found that hits are less that this value, hide the pagination.

comments.body: You can use the noRefinement css class to hide it
